The already-audited mirror has been realigned to EVEN at 6/10 with Illaoi holding levels 4-5 and the two-item stage, so this page has to read the same two rows and the same rating or mirror-fix will overwrite it.
audit.corrected: diff to EVEN, diffRating to 6/10, tone to the even amber, difficulty and final-rating prose brought with them; rows 3 and 6 flipped to Illaoi in both layers as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike says to never commit into an up Subjugate but never says how long that lasts or how it compares to your own ultimate.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80s; Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s. At rank 1 they are the same 120 seconds, so 'wait for his R' is not a passive plan — it is a straight trade of ultimates, and whoever spends first loses the next window. The mirror wrote the same number from Trundle's side.
audit.corrected: The 120s-versus-120s comparison written into report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice is treated purely as a threat to dodge ('Dodge his E pillar', 'Get pillar-kited from your field'), Frozen Domain is credited with 'lifesteal', and Chomp is called a vague 'Q shred'.
audit.why: Read together, two Riot descriptions reverse the pillar advice: Prophet of an Elder God spawns Tentacles 'on nearby impassible terrain', and Pillar of Ice 'creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain'. His zoning tool builds the field he is trying to keep you out of, so the play is to fight beside the pillar, not away from it. On Frozen Domain (W, 18/17/16/15/14s, 750 range) Riot says he gains 'Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it' — it is a healing amplifier, not lifesteal, which changes when Grievous Wounds is worth buying. On Chomp (Q, 3.5s, 300 range): it damages, briefly slows and 'saps some of their Attack Damage', and the kit flags it as an auto-attack reset — so the wind-up is the tell, and every trade leaves your slams hitting for less.
audit.corrected: Pillar advice reversed in dosFull[2], report[5] and spikes[0]; the healing amplification and the AD sap written in place of the lifesteal and 'shred' language.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate is the tracked cooldown with no number, and Chomp's 3.5 seconds appears nowhere.
audit.why: Chomp 3.5s flat, Frozen Domain 18s at rank 1, Pillar of Ice 21s at rank 1, Subjugate 120/100/80s — against Harsh Lesson at 4s and Test of Spirit at 16s. A 21-second Pillar is the longest thing he casts and, given it spawns Tentacles for you, it is the cooldown worth counting rather than fearing.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern' does not say what makes his healing a problem.
audit.why: King's Tribute heals him off every nearby unit death — a wave is a heal engine — and Frozen Domain multiplies healing from all sources on top of it. That is why the _missing file flags both needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated for this pairing: the anti-heal is the item that matters and raw armour is not.
audit.corrected: Frozen Domain's healing amplification named in report[8].

notes: The Pillar-of-Ice interaction is written at Medium confidence and deliberately matched to the mirror, which reversed the same advice first and asked for a second pair of eyes. It is an inference from two Riot descriptions read together (Prophet of an Elder God spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain; Pillar of Ice becomes impassable terrain), not from a derived flag — but it is not confirmed anywhere in the local data that a Pillar counts as valid Tentacle-spawn terrain, or for how long. QUESTION for the user: Illaoi vs Trundle, fields dosFull[2].d / report[5].t / spikes[0].text — should the page tell a player to fight beside Pillar of Ice on the strength of that inference, or hold it until someone confirms on the Wiki? Both directions currently say yes, so they are at least consistent. Standing Illaoi flag misfires left unwritten: Leap of Faith does not ground or grant untargetability, Test of Spirit does not slow.
